author: alex
headline: Added JWT refresh tokens with rotation
summary: Implemented short-lived (15 min) access tokens plus refresh tokens that rotate on every use, revoking the previous token. Chosen over a single long-lived refresh token to limit the blast radius of a stolen token.

decisions.title: Rotate refresh tokens on every use
decisions.chosen: Rotate the refresh token on each use and revoke the old one.
decisions.reason: Rotation limits the damage if a refresh token is stolen.
